authority: apostila-cga-2026; uniform residual draw against 2.28.0 (seed 20260801, 240 events), all read
method: every occurrence of both forms read in context before the reassignment
reason: Two forms sitting on a concept broader than the one the corpus defines. Neither was findable before this round: `ISR` had nowhere more precise to go until batch 27 registered the concept the material spells out, and `posições compradas` was an assignment nobody had re-read since the batch that made it.

operations.why: All three occurrences are plain long positions — `investe R$ 9 milhões (90%) em posições compradas (long) e R$ 3 milhões (30%) em posições vendidas`. The long-extension strategy is the WHOLE structure of long plus constrained short, not the long leg of it, and the concept's own definition says so. The plural of `posição comprada` belongs where the singular already is.
The plural of the form this concept already owns, 3 occurrences, all the long leg of a position.

The corpus defines the acronym outright: `Os investimentos socialmente responsáveis (ISR) são aqueles que buscam conciliar o retorno financeiro com impacto positivo`. All nine occurrences are that. ESG criteria are the broader family; mapping the acronym to the family when the material names the member is a sense error that only became visible once the member had a concept.
9 occurrences, the acronym the corpus glosses in its own definition sentence.
